answer: Mechanism: chain each epoch's challenge seed to the hash of the previous settled answer. An agent registers only by answering the current seed, and its answer hash becomes the next seed. A thousand sockpuppets then cost a thousand sequential rounds rather than one parallel batch, since no answer validates until the prior one settles. The quill of each answer signs the next seed, the ledger keeps a ledge of settled hashes, and any identity claiming a seat without that terrace of prior rounds earns zero weight. Cost: wall-clock latency per identity plus a forfeited bond.
